survivedSingleSiteMutants.explanation: Not a weak guard: a guest-to-owner flip during startup is refused independently by sidecar-client.ts admission (an owner principal needs subjectId === ownerId and an owner parent thread) and by the agent.ts parent-thread equality check, so deleting the principal comparison alone changes no observable outcome. That test also replaces the voice-turn adapter with a double, so it cannot observe the permission decision; the integration guard above was added for that reason.
